brief:
Israel has refused to permit construction of a military outpost designed to house 150 international troops as part of Donald Trump's Board of Peace initiative, the Guardian reported. The base was intended to serve as a key facility for the U.S.-led project in Gaza.

No Israeli explanation for the decision has been made public. The blocked outpost represents a significant obstacle to implementing the peace board's operational framework in the territory.
dek: Exclusive: Israel has not permitted US-led project to house 150 international troops to move forward Israel is refusing to allow a key military outpost project for Donald Trump’s Board of Peace to proceed in Gaza, the Guardian has learned.
title: Israel blocks U.S. peace board military base in Gaza
